note: Every limit this machine imposes, measured rather than assumed. Nothing in Go or in a script may carry one of these numbers: they are readings from one laptop, and anyone reproducing these choices is on different silicon. docs/TECH.md says how each was measured.
gpu_wired_cap_mb: deliberately not carried. scripts/gpulimit.sh reads the cap from Metal at runtime, so a number here would duplicate a reading already taken; and a raise applied by scripts/gpuraise.sh is a sysctl a reboot undoes, which makes it an override somebody applied rather than a limit this machine imposes. 0042 measured that the derived 21,845 MiB is what refuses the draft head at 49,152 and that 24,576 admits it.

desk_profiles.name: attended
desk_profiles.why: the largest context that left the compositor drawing; 65536 stalled it for a whole run while every request still succeeded

desk_profiles.name: unattended
desk_profiles.why: the largest context measured to serve at all — nobody is watching, so the desktop cannot be lost
